title: sutra_status MCP tool
description:
## Parent

sutra/1 — prd for sutra watcher daemon

## What to build

New `sutra_status` MCP tool that replaces `sutra_add_root` as the session-start call. Takes `path` and optional `languages` (same inputs as `sutra_add_root`).

Behavior:
1. Check if daemon is alive via HTTP to `SUTRA_LISTEN_ADDR`
2. Daemon alive: `POST /workspaces` to register, block up to 10s if daemon is doing initial parse, return workspace status
3. Daemon not alive: fall back to local mode — register workspace locally, parse if needed (same as current `sutra_add_root`), return status

Response: `{ workspace, root, mode (daemon|local), status (ready|parsing|empty), last_parse, files, symbols, smriti_connected, is_stale }`

`sutra_add_root` remains as explicit "force reparse" tool. Agent CLAUDE.md instruction changes from `sutra_add_root` to `sutra_status`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `sutra_status` tool registered in MCP server
- [ ] Daemon alive path: registers workspace via POST /workspaces, returns daemon mode status
- [ ] Daemon not alive path: falls back to local parse, returns local mode status
- [ ] Blocks up to 10s for initial parse when daemon is parsing a new workspace
- [ ] Response includes mode, status, last_parse, files, symbols, smriti_connected, is_stale
- [ ] `sutra_add_root` still works as force-reparse
- [ ] Agent CLAUDE.md updated: sutra_status replaces sutra_add_root as session-start call

## Blocked by

- sutra/5 — REST endpoints + service install
